podcast.title: Image vs. Reality
podcast.body: Les McKeown, a member of the Bay City Rollers, commented on the stark contrast between his carefully constructed public image as a "milk drinking clean living virgin" and the subsequent media portrayal of him as a "drug crazed hell raising fallen idle" once the illusion shattered. "Less McHughan said in the 70s I was the milk drinking clean living virgin that the Bay City Rollers manager made me when that illusion was shattered. I was the drug crazed hell raising fallen idle that the press made me..."
